ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT made as of this 27th day of October, 2011 (this“Agreement")between ST. MARKS-4TH AVE. REALTY CORP., a New York corporation, having an address at c/o Mary Jane D'Amato, 561 College Avenue, Staten Island, New York 10302 ("Owner") and 79 4th AVENUE LLC, a New York limited liability company and 85 4th AVENUE LLC, a New Suite 205, Brooklyn, New York 11215 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain parcels of land known by the street address of 84-86 St. Marks Place, 88 St.Marks Place,90 St. Marks Place and 92 St. Marks Place, which are respectively, Lots 14, 16, 17 and 18 in Block 934 on the Tax Map of King County, City and State of New York, more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, (said land is herein referred to as “Owner's Parcel", said buildings and improvements are herein collectively referred to as “Owner's Building” and said land, building and improvements being herein collectively referred to as the “Owner's Property"); and WHEREAS, Developer owns that certain tract, plot and parcel of land, known by the street address of 79 4"h Avenue, 85 4"h Avenue, 87 4th Avenue, 89 4"h Avenue and 80-82 St. Marks Place, which are respectively, Lots 5, 6, 7, 10 and 12 in Block 934 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, all as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land, other than Lot 10, is herein referred to as “Developer's Parcel", said buildings and improvements are herein collectively referred to as “Developer's Building” and said land, building and improvements being herein collectively referred to as the “Developer's Property"; and each of Owner's Parcel and Development Parcel is sometimes referred to as"Parcel"); and WHEREAS, Owner's Parcel and Developer's Parcel are contiguous for more than ten (10) linear feet and are within a single block pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended (the “Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new or altered building upon all or a portion of Developer's Parcel and desires to construct a building that contains more floor area, as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution (herein referred to as “Floor Area"), than is now available for use under the Zoning Resolution for Developer's Parcel as an independent “zoning lot,” and so Developer desires to combine the Developer's Parcel and the Owner's Parcel into a single “zoning lot” to enable Developer's Building to incorporate the lesser of (i) all of the certain rights, as determined by the Zoning Resolution, that are appurtenant to a zoning lot, whereby such zoning lot may be developed by erecting thereon one or more structures with Floor Area determined by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the allowable Floor Area Ratio (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) in that zoning district, (herein referred to as "Floor Area Development Rights"), that are appurtenant to Lots 17 and 18 ("Owner's Designated Land") on the date hereof and (i) 1,760.00 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights (such lesser amount, the “Designated Development Rights") into the new construction in Developer'sParcel;
